roadmap.title: Baghdad story campaign
roadmap.description: Play the main story from the prologue through "In Pursuit of Truth", collecting both disguises for Masquerader and putting a key-carrying guard to sleep for You Snooze, You Lose before their missable windows close.

roadmap.title: Baghdad open-world completion
roadmap.description: After the story, clear every district and side activity: all collectibles and viewpoints, Tales and contracts, skill and tool upgrades, and the combat, stealth, notoriety, and pickpocket counters.

roadmap.title: Valley of Memory expansion
roadmap.description: Complete the free AlUla storyline and clear the region: stolen goods for Hind, all folktales and Oud melodies, the undetected prison escape, and every AlUla territory.

roadmap.title: Animus Sequences and final skills
roadmap.description: Replay missions and contracts from the Animus Sequences menu to clear a full challenge set, then bank 93 challenge points for all rewards; use the earned skill points if Self-Improvement is still short.

achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{prologue} and reach the docks where @npc{Roshan} waits.

steps.text: Play through the prologue until Basim reaches the docks where @npc{Roshan} is waiting.

achievements.description: Complete the story quest Taking Flight.
achievements.summary: Complete the story quest @mechanic{Taking Flight}, where Basim joins the Hidden Ones as an Initiate.

steps.text: Finish the quest @mechanic{Taking Flight} in @loc{Alamut}.

achievements.summary: Assassinate @enemy{Al-Ghul} during the quest @mechanic{First Order}.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{First Order} and eliminate @enemy{Al-Ghul}.

achievements.summary: Assassinate @enemy{Al-Rabisu} during the quest @mechanic{The Great Symposium}.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{The Great Symposium} and eliminate @enemy{Al-Rabisu}.

achievements.summary: Assassinate @enemy{Al-Pairika} during the quest @mechanic{Gilded Butterflies}.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{Gilded Butterflies} and eliminate @enemy{Al-Pairika}.

achievements.summary: Assassinate @enemy{Al-Mardikhwar} during the quest @mechanic{Den of the Beast}.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{Den of the Beast} and eliminate @enemy{Al-Mardikhwar}.

achievements.description: Assassinate the Head of the Order.
achievements.summary: Assassinate the @enemy{Head of the Order} during the quest @mechanic{The Serpent's Nest}.

steps.text: Complete the quest @mechanic{The Serpent's Nest} and eliminate the @enemy{Head of the Order}.

achievements.description: Finish the main story and discover Basim's past.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{In Pursuit of Truth}, then play the epilogue beneath @loc{Alamut}.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{In Pursuit of Truth} and the epilogue that follows beneath @loc{Alamut}.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum Hidden One Rank
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum @mechanic{Hidden One Rank} by eliminating the Order of the Ancients targets.

guide.context: Each Order target you assassinate raises your rank by one, and the final rank arrives with the hunt for the Head of the Order.

steps.text: Play the main story and eliminate each @enemy{Order of the Ancients} target; the rank reaches maximum in @mechanic{The Serpent's Nest}.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 23 skills across the Phantom, Trickster, and Hunter skill trees.

guide.context: The Valley of Memory update adds a 24th skill, but the achievement still only requires the 23 original skills.

steps.text: Finish the main story, all 7 @item{lost books}, and all 6 @mechanic{Tales of Baghdad} to earn most of the 62 skill points needed.
Complete bureau contracts until you reach 62 points; each finished contract unlocks the next, and six of them award 2 points each.
Open @mechanic{Skills} from the pause menu and unlock every skill in all three trees.

achievements.summary: Buy both upgrades for one weapon at a blacksmith.

guide.context: Fully upgrading one weapon costs 90 leather, 180 steel ingots, and both of that weapon's upgrade schematics.

steps.text: Loot gear chests until you have both @item{upgrade schematics} for a single weapon.
Visit a @loc{blacksmith}, select that weapon, and pay the materials for both upgrade tiers.

achievements.summary: Buy both upgrades for one outfit at a tailor.

guide.context: Fully upgrading one outfit costs 180 leather, 90 steel ingots, and both of that outfit's upgrade schematics.

steps.text: Loot gear chests until you have both @item{upgrade schematics} for a single outfit.
Visit a @loc{tailor}, select that outfit, and pay the materials for both upgrade tiers.

achievements.summary: Apply a dye to an outfit.

guide.context: Each dye fits one specific outfit, so equip other outfits if the dye cannot be selected.

steps.text: Buy a dye from a trader or loot one from an enigma treasure, then open @mechanic{Inventory} > @mechanic{Outfit Dye} and apply it to a compatible outfit.

achievements.description: Obtain the two disguises in Baghdad
achievements.summary: Obtain both disguises in Baghdad: the white patient robe and the eunuch tunic.

guide.context: Both disguises belong to story missions, and the eunuch tunic is lost once its mission is over.

steps.text: During @mechanic{The Great Symposium}, take the @item{white patient robe} from the cells beneath the @loc{House of Wisdom}.
During @mechanic{The Servant and the Impostor}, take a tunic from a eunuch on a rooftop near the @loc{Harem}; mark the eunuchs with @mechanic{Enkidu} to find the easiest one.

achievements.summary: Open a token chest with a merchant favor token.

guide.context: Token chests are the rarer loot chests that each demand 1 merchant favor token, which comes from pickpocketing.

steps.text: Pickpocket a civilian for a @item{merchant favor token}, then spend it to open a token chest.

achievements.summary: Obtain 10 elixirs from traders or tool chests.

guide.context: Basim can carry only 3 elixirs at a time, so heal after taking damage to free slots for more.

steps.text: Buy or loot @item{elixirs} and keep topping up; take damage and heal whenever your 3 slots are full.

achievements.description: Synchronize all Viewpoints in the Baghdad region
achievements.summary: Synchronize all 21 viewpoints in the Baghdad region.

guide.context: Viewpoints unfog the map, reveal nearby collectibles, and become fast-travel points once synchronized.

steps.text: Climb each @mechanic{viewpoint} and press the synchronize prompt; 21 of them spread across the five Baghdad districts.

achievements.summary: Tag 100 guards using @npc{Enkidu}.

guide.context: Enkidu unlocks early in the story, and guards in crowded restricted areas rebuild the count quickly.

steps.text: Summon @npc{Enkidu}, zoom in on a guard, and hold on them until marked; repeat until 100 guards are tagged.

achievements.description: Explore all the Baghdad region territories
achievements.summary: Complete every collectible in all five Baghdad districts.

guide.context: District trackers demand every @item{enigma scroll} plus the five other collectible types, but the enigmas themselves need no solving; @loc{Wilderness} counts as the fifth district.

steps.text: Synchronize every viewpoint so the map reveals collectibles nearby.

Clear every tracker item in @loc{Harbiyah}, @loc{Abbasiyah}, @loc{Karkh}, @loc{Round City}, and @loc{Wilderness}: gear chests, lost books, enigma scrolls, historical sites, mysterious shards, and Tales of Baghdad.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 faction contracts.

guide.context: Contracts unlock after @mechanic{Zeroing In} and are accepted from the job board in a Hidden Ones' bureau; each completion unlocks another contract.

steps.text: Take jobs from the bureau board and complete 10 @mechanic{faction contracts}.

achievements.summary: Complete one Tale from Baghdad.

steps.text: Finish any one of the 6 @mechanic{Tales of Baghdad} marked on the map.

achievements.summary: Collect all 7 lost books and bring them to @npc{Al-Jahiz}.

guide.context: One book in the @loc{Wilderness} ruins never appears on the map; search the region's far bottom-right corner.

steps.text: Collect the 7 @item{lost books} scattered across the five districts.
Deliver them all to @npc{Al-Jahiz}.

achievements.description: Obtain a treasure by solving an enigma
achievements.summary: Solve one enigma puzzle to obtain its treasure.

guide.context: Only one enigma needs solving, but every enigma scroll still counts toward Explorer.

steps.text: Pick up an @item{enigma scroll}, follow its written clue, and loot the treasure at the spot it describes.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade every tool at the Hidden Ones' bureau.

guide.context: Finishing every tool costs 1460 components, 675 steel ingots, and 675 leather; giving a trader 7 merchant favor tokens cuts prices by 30%.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Branching Out}, buy the @mechanic{Extra Tool Capacity} skills, and speak to @npc{Banu Musa} to unlock every tool.
Farm @item{components} from traders, loot chests, and contracts until you hold the full material cost.
Buy all three upgrade tiers for the throwing knife, noisemaker, trap, smoke bomb, and blowdart.

achievements.summary: Kill 75 guards with throwing knives.

guide.context: Throwing knives unlock during @mechanic{A New Beginning}; the Knife Recovery skill returns knives, and headshotted guards die more reliably.

steps.text: Throw knives at guards until 75 are dead, refilling from traders or tool chests as needed.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 guards with throwing-knife headshots.

steps.text: Aim at a guard's head and throw a knife; repeat until 20 headshots have killed.

achievements.description: Put 10 guards to sleep with blowdarts
achievements.summary: Use blowdarts to put 10 guards to sleep.

guide.context: Blowdarts unlock after completing @mechanic{Branching Out}.

steps.text: Shoot blowdarts at guards until 10 have been put to sleep.

achievements.summary: Have 10 guards trigger traps.

guide.context: Traps unlock after completing @mechanic{Branching Out}.

steps.text: Throw a trap into a guard's path and let them walk into it; repeat until 10 guards have triggered a trap.

achievements.summary: Affect 20 guards with smoke bombs.

guide.context: Smoke bombs unlock after completing @mechanic{Branching Out}.

steps.text: Let guards gather around Basim in open conflict, then use a smoke bomb to catch several at once; repeat until 20 are affected.

achievements.summary: Distract 10 guards with noisemakers.

guide.context: Noisemakers unlock after completing @mechanic{Branching Out}.

steps.text: Throw a noisemaker near guards so they walk over to investigate; repeat until 10 guards have been distracted.

achievements.summary: Pickpocket 50 people.

guide.context: The Guaranteed Pickpocket setting removes the timing prompt and still counts toward the total.

steps.text: Pickpocket civilians one after another; the @loc{Bazaar} in @loc{Karkh} has the densest crowd of targets.

achievements.description: Pickpocket a guard affected by a blowdart
achievements.summary: Pickpocket a sleeping guard who carries a key or a mysterious shard.

guide.context: Only key-carrying soldiers and the 10 mysterious shard carriers work; once their key or shard is looted they never respawn, so this can become impossible late in the game.

steps.text: Unlock the @item{blowdart} by completing @mechanic{Branching Out}.
Find a soldier with an orange key icon, or an open-world guard carrying a @item{mysterious shard}; the armored guard on the @loc{Bazaar} rooftop in @loc{Karkh} is a dependable target.
Shoot the blowdart at the guard's unarmored legs, then pickpocket the sleeping guard.

achievements.description: Pickpocket all 18 artifacts and deliver them to Dervis.
achievements.summary: Pickpocket all 18 Dervis artifacts and deliver them to @npc{Dervis}.

guide.context: Artifacts appear only after you meet Dervis following the prologue, and their carriers are marked by golden pickpocket icons on the map.

steps.text: Follow the golden pickpocket icons across Baghdad and steal all 18 @item{artifacts}.
Bring the artifacts to @npc{Dervis}.

achievements.summary: Hold 2007 dirhams at the same time.

guide.context: The Pickpocket Master skill raises the value of stolen goods, and selling loot to traders is the fastest income.

steps.text: Pickpocket civilians and sell the loot until your purse holds 2007 @item{dirhams} at once.

achievements.description: Use benches to pass time 5 times
achievements.summary: Use a bench to pass time 5 times.

steps.text: Sit on a bench, hold the pass-time button, and repeat until you have passed time 5 times; the same bench can be reused.

achievements.summary: Pay musicians 5 times.

guide.context: Each musician costs 1 scholar token, which comes from pickpocketing.

steps.text: Pickpocket @item{scholar tokens}, then pay 5 musicians marked by music-note icons on the map.

achievements.summary: Pay mercenaries 5 times.

guide.context: Each mercenary costs 1 power token, and the same mercenary can be paid again after enemies respawn.

steps.text: Pickpocket @item{power tokens}, then pay 5 mercenaries marked by sword icons on the map.

achievements.summary: Pay merchant groups 5 times.

guide.context: Each group costs 1 merchant token, and fast-travelling between groups makes them respawn so the same one can be paid again.

steps.text: Pickpocket @item{merchant tokens}, then pay 5 merchant groups.

achievements.description: Assassinate 10 guards while blending with the crowd
achievements.summary: Assassinate 10 guards while blending with a crowd.

guide.context: This trigger can fail with upgraded gear; equip the starting outfit and weapons with no dye and no talisman if kills stop counting.

steps.text: Stand among at least 3 people until Basim's silhouette turns white, whistle a guard over, and assassinate when prompted; repeat until 10 guards are down.

achievements.summary: Assassinate 10 guards from hiding spots.

guide.context: Tall grass, gazebos, benches, and hay carts are all valid, and the same spot can be reused after the guards respawn through fast travel.

steps.text: Hide in a hay cart, tall grass, bench, or gazebo near a guard, whistle to lure them close, then assassinate; repeat until 10 guards are down.

achievements.summary: Defeat a @enemy{Shakiriyya} in combat.

guide.context: Shakiriyya are the masked dual-blade elites that hunt Basim once notoriety reaches level 3, and stealth attacks barely wound them.

steps.text: Kill in front of witnesses until notoriety reaches level 3 and a loud cue announces a @enemy{Shakiriyya}.
Fight the Shakiriyya with melee, smoke bombs, and traps until it is dead.

achievements.summary: Throw a knife to destroy a horn bearer's horn.

guide.context: The horn rides on the guard's back and glows when you scan with @mechanic{Eagle Vision}; it can still be destroyed after the guard dies.

steps.text: Scan to highlight the horn, then throw a knife at it; a horn bearer at the @loc{Metal Factory} in @loc{Harbiyah} is easy to reach from behind.

achievements.description: Stay at maximum notoriety for 10 minutes
achievements.summary: Stay at maximum notoriety for 10 unbroken minutes.

guide.context: Killing the Shakiriyya, ripping a wanted poster, or paying a Munadi resets notoriety and restarts the timer.

steps.text: Reach notoriety level 3, then stay alive for 10 minutes without lowering it, either in a secluded spot or by dodging the Shakiriyya.

achievements.description: Lower maximum notoriety by ripping wanted posters only
achievements.summary: Drop from maximum notoriety to anonymous using only wanted posters.

guide.context: Paying a Munadi instead voids the achievement, and the on-screen compass tracks the nearest wanted poster.

steps.text: Reach notoriety level 3, then rip 3 @item{wanted posters} until the red bar is empty.

achievements.description: Use the services of a Munadi 3 times
achievements.summary: Use a Munadi's service 3 times.

guide.context: Each service costs 1 power token and becomes available once notoriety is above zero.

steps.text: Pickpocket @item{power tokens}, raise a little notoriety, then pay a Munadi 3 times.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards with one use of Assassin's Focus.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 guards with a single use of @mechanic{Assassin's Focus}.

guide.context: Five chained kills need the @mechanic{Assassin's Focus Capacity} 1 and 2 skills for a full 5-bar gauge, and the bars refill through stealth kills.

steps.text: Buy both @mechanic{Assassin's Focus Capacity} skills, then refill all 5 bars with stealth kills.
Out of combat, use Assassin's Focus on 5 guards standing together; a cluster waits outside the @loc{Great Garrison} in @loc{Karkh}.

achievements.summary: Survive 10 minutes in one open conflict.

guide.context: The timer restarts if combat ends, line of sight breaks, or the last enemy dies.

steps.text: Pick a fight with a lone guard, then dodge or parry for 10 minutes without killing them or leaving combat.

achievements.summary: Collapse 20 scaffolding structures.

guide.context: Scaffolds respawn after fast-travelling far enough away, so a single structure can be destroyed again and again.

steps.text: Collapse a scaffold, fast-travel to a distant viewpoint, return to the respawned structure, and repeat until 20 are down.

achievements.description: Assassinate 10 guards in a row without triggering open conflict
achievements.summary: Assassinate 10 guards consecutively without ever entering open conflict.

guide.context: The kills need not happen back to back, but any detection breaks the streak; enemies respawn after fast travel so easy targets can be reused.

steps.text: Take out lone guards from stealth with the hidden blade, throwing knives, or blowdarts in a restricted area such as @loc{Damascus Gate Prison} until 10 kills count.

achievements.description: Hide 5 bodies in bales of hay
achievements.summary: Hide 5 bodies inside bales of hay.

guide.context: Civilian corpses count too, and several bodies can be stuffed into the same bale.

steps.text: Kill or knock out a target, carry the body to a hay bale or hay cart, and hide it; repeat until 5 bodies are hidden.

achievements.description: Return all stolen goods to Hind
achievements.summary: Return all 8 stolen goods to @npc{Hind}.

guide.context: Stolen goods unlock after the quest @mechanic{The Ones Who Remain}; each item can only be recovered once its clue has been looted from a bandit camp.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{The Ones Who Remain} to unlock @npc{Hind} at @loc{Nimlot's Estate}.
Loot clues from bandit camps across @loc{AlUla}, follow each clue to its hidden item, and return all 8 stolen goods to @npc{Hind}.

achievements.summary: Listen to all 5 folktales in @loc{AlUla}.

guide.context: Each folktale starts when you sit on the bench beside its storyteller and must be heard to the end.

steps.text: Find the 5 folktale benches spread across @loc{AlUla} and sit through every story.

achievements.summary: Collect all 6 Oud melodies.

guide.context: Five @item{Oud melodies} float above high places and blow away when approached, while the sixth is a reward from @mechanic{In the Vulture's Nest}.

steps.text: Chase each floating melody along its wind path and grab the sheet before it resets.
Finish @mechanic{In the Vulture's Nest} to receive the final melody.

achievements.summary: Replay one Animus Sequence.

guide.context: Animus Sequences open from the @mechanic{Animus Sequences} tab on the investigation board or from Animus icons in the world.

steps.text: Open an Animus Sequence and replay a mission or contract once.

achievements.description: Complete all challenges of an Animus Sequence
achievements.summary: Complete all 4 challenges in a single Animus Sequence replay.

guide.context: A short contract is the quickest sequence to sweep clean in one attempt.

steps.text: Replay a short contract from the Animus Sequence menu and clear all 4 of its challenges in one attempt.

achievements.summary: Unlock every Animus Sequence reward by earning 93 challenge points.

guide.context: The reward track holds 108 points in total, and each replayable sequence awards up to 4, so 24 clean clears fill it while leaving room for failures.

steps.text: Replay sequences and clear their challenges until the reward track on the right of the menu reaches 93 points.

achievements.summary: Poison a poisoner.

guide.context: Poisoners camp with robbers and near the tomb in @loc{Hegra}; the Hidden One's sword poisons on every fifth hit.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{poisoner} and strike them with the Hidden One's sword until the poison lands.

achievements.summary: Complete every territory in @loc{AlUla}.

guide.context: Territory completion counts open-world activities and collectibles, but stolen goods only need their clues found; the cartographer in the @loc{Northern Wilds} sells maps that mark anything missing.

steps.text: Clear the activities and collectibles of each @loc{AlUla} territory until every regional tracker is full.

achievements.summary: Escape the @loc{AlUla} prison during @mechanic{The Heart of Corruption}.

steps.text: Play the DLC quest @mechanic{The Heart of Corruption} until Basim escapes the prison.

achievements.summary: Say goodbye to @npc{Is'haq} at the end of @mechanic{In the Vulture's Nest}.

steps.text: Finish the DLC quest @mechanic{In the Vulture's Nest}; the farewell plays out at the end.

achievements.summary: Escape the @loc{AlUla} prison without being detected.

guide.context: Replaying @mechanic{The Heart of Corruption} from the Animus Sequence menu lowers the guard density and makes a silent escape easier.

steps.text: Reach the prison break in @mechanic{The Heart of Corruption} and leave without any guard spotting you; restart the sequence if the alarm raises.
